about: Shared demo data of all shrippen projects: Studio Weber, a small film and media studio in Hamburg. Everything is made up. Dates are day offsets from the anchor (Monday of the week that contains 'today', DEMO_TODAY=YYYY-MM-DD fixes 'today'). Texts are {de, en}. Edit this file, then run demo/tools/sync-demo.py. See demo/README.md.

timesheet_weeks.note: Each person has week templates; week w uses templates[w mod n]. Rows: [weekday 0=Mon, project, activity, start, end, description]. Days covered by an absence or a public holiday are skipped. Consumers drop rows after 'now'.
